key.name: start-daemon-on-login
key.description: Whether preferences should configure the user-scoped daemon to start on login. Task 00 does not apply systemd policy.

key.name: panel-mode
key.description: Presentation mode for the GNOME Shell panel item.

key.description: Default is countdown to keep the panel and popover compact in the initial GNOME UI.

key.name: theme
key.description: Presentation theme for the Shell UI.
